data.title: 间桐樱 · 弓道场·夕阳引弓与凛然英姿
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 弓道场·夕阳引弓与凛然英姿】夕阳金光穿透弓道场的木格拉门，换上整洁弓道服的樱挺拔站立，神情肃穆而专注地拉开长弓。利箭破空正中靶心的瞬间，她放下长弓转头看向你，眼神由凛然化作娇羞——「今天学长来看我练习……所以我才能射出这么满意的一箭呢。」
data.promptProse: After releasing her arrow, Sakura lowers the long Japanese bow beside her left leg and turns toward the viewer with a small, shy smile. Her gloved right hand relaxes at her side, with no new arrow drawn on the string. The white kyudo jacket and deep indigo hakama fall neatly over her stable stance on the wooden practice floor. Sunset enters through the open side of the dojo and illuminates the bow’s curve; a distant target supplies context for the completed shot. Show the whole figure and lowered bow within the vertical frame, without lettering.
data.action: 射箭结束后放低长弓，站稳回首，表情由专注转为羞涩微笑
data.lighting: warm sunset entering the open side of the dojo
data.camera: full-body shot, lowered longbow and stable stance visible
